items.title: 2.11 Do dimensions mein inelastic takrao (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 2.11 with Fig. 2.17 (PDF 46-48, printed 43-45).

blocks.text: Bare paimane (macroscopic) ke takrao aam taur par inelastic hote hain aur kinetic energy barqarar nahi rakhte.
Perfectly inelastic takrao woh hai jis mein takrane wali cheezen chipak kar ek hi mass ban jati hain. Is ka hisaab yun hai:

Do sakht (rigid) jism lein jin ke mass m₁ aur m₂ hain aur jo xy-plane (do dimensions) mein v⃗₁i aur v⃗₂i velocities se chal rahe hain. Pehla jism x-axis ke saath chal raha hai aur doosra x-axis se angle θ bana kar. Dono origin par takrate hain (Fig. 2.17).

blocks.alt: Axes x aur y. Jism m1 x-axis ke saath velocity v1i se asal ki taraf chalta hai; jism m2 x-axis se zawiya theta wali lakeer par velocity v2i se asal ki taraf. Asal par takra kar mila hua jism velocity vf se x-axis se zawiya phi par oopar nikalta hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 2.17: Do dimensions mein perfectly inelastic takrao (kitab ki Figure 2.17 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Takrao ke baad dono chipak jate hain; mila hua mass M = m₁ + m₂ hai jo velocity v⃗f se x-axis ke saath angle φ bana kar chalta hai. Ab v⃗₂i ke rectangular components v⃗₂i sin θ aur v⃗₂i cos θ lein, aur v⃗f ke v⃗f sin φ aur v⃗f cos φ. (Equations mein pehle jism ka angle θ₁ aur doosre ka θ₂ likha hai; pehla jism x-axis par ho to θ₁ = 0.)
x-simt mein momentum:

blocks.text_alt: m₁v₁i cos θ₁ + m₂v₂i cos θ₂ = Mv⃗f cos φ   (2.39)

blocks.text: y-simt mein momentum:

blocks.text_alt: m₁v₁i sin θ₁ + m₂v₂i sin θ₂ = Mv⃗f sin φ   (2.40)

blocks.text: Final velocity aur angle nikalna
Final velocity vf ki miqdar:
Equations (2.39) aur (2.40) ka square le kar jama karein (cos²φ + sin²φ = 1):

blocks.text_alt: vf = √([(m₁v₁i cos θ₁ + m₂v₂i cos θ₂)/M]² + [(m₁v₁i sin θ₁ + m₂v₂i sin θ₂)/M]²)   (2.41)

blocks.text: Final angle φ:
x-axis ke saath v⃗f ka angle φ nikalne ke liye y-momentum wali equation (2.40) ko x-momentum wali equation (2.39) se taqseem karein (sin φ / cos φ = tan φ):

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab likhti hai ke φ equations (2.40) ko (2.41) se taqseem karne se milta hai. Sahi yeh hai ke y-momentum wali (2.40) ko x-momentum wali (2.39) se taqseem karein; (2.41) to vf ki miqdar hai.

blocks.text_alt: φ = tan⁻¹[(m₁v₁i sin θ₁ + m₂v₂i sin θ₂)/(m₁v₁i cos θ₁ + m₂v₂i cos θ₂)]   (2.42)

blocks.text: φ woh simt hai jis mein chipke hue dono jism takrao ke baad x-axis ke saath chalte hain. m₁, m₂, M, θ₁, θ₂, φ aur v⃗₁i, v⃗₂i, v⃗f ki qeematen (2.39) aur (2.40) mein rakh kar is soorat mein momentum ka conservation sabit kiya ja sakta hai.
Kinetic energy
Takrao inelastic hai, is liye system ki kinetic energy barqarar nahi rehti. Nuqsan yun nikalte hain:
Initial (shuru ki) kinetic energy
Takrao se pehle system ki kul kinetic energy:
K.E. scalar hai, is liye is formula mein velocities ko components mein torne ki zaroorat nahi; seedhi speed lagti hai.
Final (aakhri) kinetic energy
Takrao ke baad (jab cheezen chipak jayen) kul kinetic energy:
Yahan vf final velocity ki miqdar hai jo Eq. (2.41) se milti hai.
Takrao mein energy ka nuqsan
Takrao inelastic hai, is liye kinetic energy kam hoti hai; is kami ko ΔK.E. kehte hain:
Yeh zaya hui kinetic energy doosri shakalon mein badal jati hai, jaise garmi, awaz ya shakal ka bigarna (deformation).
m₁, m₂, M aur v₁i², v₂i², vf² ko equations (2.43) aur (2.44) mein rakh kar takrao se pehle aur baad ki kinetic energy aur zaya energy nikal sakte hain.
Inelastic takrao ki kuch misalein:

items: Karate ka waar eenton ka dher torta hai: yeh inelastic takrao hai. Takrao ke baad cheezen wapas nahi uchhaltin; waar ki kuch energy eenten jazb (absorb) kar leti hain, jo garmi, awaz aur eenten torne wali force ban jati hai. Yani energy haath ko wapas uchhalne ke bajaye eenten torne mein lagti hai. Agar waar bilkul seedha (vertical) na ho aur kuch horizontal harkat bhi ho, to momentum ki muntaqili aur forces ke horizontal aur vertical dono components honge.

Car ke hadse (crash) mein takrao horizontal aur vertical dono simton mein inelastic hota hai. Gariyan takrao ki energy jazb kar ke pichak jati hain aur shakal badalti hai. Isi wajah se woh dheemi ho jati hain aur wapas nahi uchhaltin. Zyada tar kinetic energy garmi, awaz aur gariyon ke nuqsan mein chali jati hai.

Bat aur gend bhi inelastic takrao dikhate hain. Bat gend ko maare to gend dabti hai aur kuch kinetic energy zaya hoti hai; kuch energy garmi aur awaz ban jati hai. Bat sakht hai phir bhi poori energy aage nahi deta, kuch khud jazb karta hai. Gend ke dabne se mazeed energy zaya hoti hai. Is liye shuru ki saari kinetic energy barqarar nahi rehti aur takrao inelastic hai.

m₁v₁i sin θ₁ + m₂v₂i sin θ₂ = Mvf sin φ

blocks.prompt: 2 kg ka jism x-axis ke saath 3 m s⁻¹ se chal raha hai aur x se 90° par 3 m s⁻¹ se chalte 1 kg ke jism se chipak jata hai. Mushtarka velocity aur zaya energy nikalein.
blocks.explanation: x: 2 × 3 + 0 = 3vf cos φ = 6; y: 0 + 1 × 3 = 3vf sin φ = 3. Is liye vf = √(6² + 3²)/3 = √45/3 = 2.24 m s⁻¹ aur φ = tan⁻¹(3/6) = 26.6°. (K.E)i = ½(2)(9) + ½(1)(9) = 13.5 J; (K.E)f = ½(3)(5) = 7.5 J; 6 J garmi, awaz aur bigaar mein zaya.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: Do jism origin par chipakte hain: momentum x (2.39) aur y (2.40) dono mein barqarar; vf = squares ke majmooe ka jazr ÷ M (2.41), φ = tan⁻¹(y/x) (2.42); pehle (2.43) aur baad (2.44) ki K.E. ka farq garmi, awaz aur bigaar ka nuqsan hai. Misalein: karate waar, car crash, bat aur gend.
